title: Update status to include locked days
description: This PR updates the status query to return locked days too. For a dashboard I'm building I need a way to differentiate days where there is no puzzle (relevant for 2025 since there are only 12 days) vs. days where there is a puzzle but no stars are earned yet. One way to support this is to add locked days to the status list - this way status gives visibility into all puzzles for a year. This change seems like it could be generally useful for others too. **Before:** **After:**

Prepare elf 1.2.0 for release
description:
- Add calendar-aware defaults, account-isolated caching, safer submissions, and elf doctor.
- Add first/last star timestamps and cached CSV/JSON leaderboard exports.
- Add elf new with an interactive # %% puzzle template.
- Improve HTTP errors, concurrency safety, cooldown handling, and backward compatibility.
- Add Python 3.11–3.14 cross-platform CI, packaging validation, and trusted PyPI publishing.
- Update documentation, tests, release notes, and metadata for snally-dev/elf.
- Add First Star (UTC) and Last Star (UTC) leaderboard columns, showing each member’s earliest and latest completion timestamps for the year. (Fix #5)

All 98 tests pass; linting, typing, wheel/sdist builds, and clean-install checks pass.
